product_facts.text: Luna desk lamp: 8 W, USB-C power, warm-white light.
Production lead time is 18 days after deposit.
One evaluation sample can be arranged. Shipping and sample price need a quotation.

conversation: Mira: We are looking at 300 lamps for our autumn collection. Can you send a sample to Hamburg, and what is your best price?
goal: Respond to the sample request and collect the details needed for a quote.
